title: COF photocatalysis: H2O2 production coupled with organic transformation
description: Literature screening for a review on COF (and sibling frameworks) that produce H2O2 photocatalytically while converting an organic substrate.

object.note: The product slot. Every dimension query is ANDed with this.

dimensions.note: CTF is counted inside COF by this review's convention, but must be flagged in notes.
The acronym CMP alone is ambiguous (chemical mechanical polishing), so only the full phrase is queried.

extraQueries.why: The API renders subscripts as spaces (Bi 2 O 2 S), so a literal query misses it.
extraQueries.query: (Bi2O2S OR "Bi 2 O 2 S" OR CuInS2) AND ("hydrogen peroxide" OR H2O2)

extraQueries.why: Class-C papers consume H2O2 in situ and never name it in the abstract.
extraQueries.query: ("carbon nitride" OR C3N4) AND methane AND ethanol

output.scopeDirective: Coverage is reported on scope=COF only; sibling systems and composites are discussed but never counted into the COF denominator.
